query: '
SELECT
    patient_id AS patient_id_bk,
    full_name AS nombre_completo,
    gender AS genero,
    date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento,
    CASE
        WHEN date_of_birth IS NULL
          OR date_of_birth > CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
            THEN NULL
        WHEN date_of_birth > DATEADD(YEAR, -18, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
            THEN '0-17'
        WHEN date_of_birth > DATEADD(YEAR, -30, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
            THEN '18-29'
        WHEN date_of_birth > DATEADD(YEAR, -45, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
            THEN '30-44'
        WHEN date_of_birth > DATEADD(YEAR, -60, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
            THEN '45-59'
        ELSE '60+'
    END AS rango_etario,
    email AS correo_electronico,
    address AS direccion,
    insurance_provider AS proveedor_seguro
FROM silver.patients
',
